entries.currentBehavior: The implementation performs real HTTP and clears its timer, but successful bodies are unchecked and non-2xx errors are reduced to a string field; caller abort signals replace the internally timed signal.
entries.problem: A structurally wrong success body becomes trusted domain data; malformed JSON is accepted as a string; timeout/abort and response loss do not carry typed transport/protocol context.
preservedBehavior: Preserve JSON content type, no body requests and timer cleanup, including deadline enforcement when a caller signal is supplied. Intentionally eliminate unchecked casts, error extraction, generic safeJSON acceptance, and the use of Promise completion as an authority boundary.
